en: A vintage postcard showing a rural landscape with gentle hills and a walking path. There is a lone figure, likely a man, walking along the path. The vegetation is sparse, suggesting it is early spring or late autumn. The image is in muted colors typical of early colorized photography. The text is in Dutch and specifies the viewpoint as 'Duivelsberg'. Publisher information is at the bottom.
